name: Swimming
overview: Scripture uses the imagery of swimming and passing through waters to illustrate God's sovereign control and protective presence. The Psalmist acknowledges God's creation of the paths of the seas and the still waters that provide rest and guidance. Isaiah portrays swimming as a powerful gesture, symbolizing both human pride and God's authority to humble it. Most profoundly, God promises His presence and protection when His people pass through overwhelming waters and rivers, assuring that they will not be overcome or consumed.
